name: okaynews-chatgpt
description: Search Okay News reporting, read stories, explore context and check published naira rates.

interface.longDescription:
Search Okay News reporting by topic, person, place or news desk. Read articles with bylines and publication dates, request a daily briefing using Lagos time, and explore related coverage. The interactive reader lets you open stories, browse desks and view published naira exchange-rate observations with recent history.

AI explanations are separate from newsroom reporting. Related search matches do not establish an event chronology. Exchange-rate observations include their publication timestamps and may be stale.

The integration reads public content only. It cannot access unpublished drafts or private reports, publish articles, submit reports, vote, save profiles or register alerts.
defaultPrompt: Give me today's Okay News briefing.
Find Okay News reporting about energy in Nigeria.
Show the latest published dollar-to-naira observation.
